title: Input schema of the E-commerce Review Sentiment Scraper

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: E-commerce product URLs to scrape reviews from (Amazon, eBay, etc.).

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max Requests per Crawl
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Maximum number of products to analyze.

maxReviewsPerProduct.title: Max Reviews per Product
maxReviewsPerProduct.description: Maximum number of reviews to scrape per product (1-1000+).

minReviewRating.title: Minimum Review Rating
minReviewRating.description: Only analyze reviews with rating at or above this value (1-5).

minReviewLength.title: Minimum Review Length
minReviewLength.description: Only analyze reviews with at least this many characters.

enableAISummarization.title: Enable AI Summarization
enableAISummarization.description: Use AI to extract pros and cons from reviews.

sentimentAnalysisMethod.title: Sentiment Analysis Method
sentimentAnalysisMethod.description: Method for analyzing sentiment (simple, advanced, ai).

minFrequencyThreshold.title: Minimum Frequency Threshold
minFrequencyThreshold.description: Minimum number of times a pro/con must appear to be included.

includeExamples.title: Include Examples
includeExamples.description: Include example quotes for each pro/con.
